assessment.assessment_title: RHEL 9 must not have the ypserv package installed.
assessment.evidence_guidance: Retain the completed source OCIL evidence and reviewer notes.
assessment.procedure:
Manual alternative preserved from the original OCIL check. Follow the source procedure; this Assessment does not execute OCIL.

Verify that the ypserv package is not installed with the following command:

$ dnf list --installed ypserv

Error: No matching Packages to list

If the "ypserv" package is installed, this is a finding.
